text:
nora: rolling up ORCA-lite v1.2 (int4) to canary (a40-small). seeing sporadic slowgen spikes and a couple of soft OOMs during ramp. paste logs.

chris: can you share the canary runtime config and the traffic profile used for the ramp?

nora: baseline we used:```yaml
model: orca-lite-v1.2-int4
workload: chats-small-rapid-ramp
runtime:
  microbatch_size: 12
  max_new_tokens: 400
  prefetch_kv: true
  slot_compaction: moderate
  slab_cushion_pct: 6
```

anika: microbatch 12 + prefetch on a40 under ramp is risky for large context. fragments the freelist; compactor kicks in and we get transient allocation failures.

debug-bot: alert: host=a40-17 gen_worker: alloc_fail transient, recovered by compactor

chris: try these quick experiments: microbatch 6, max_new_tokens=256, prefetch_kv=false, slab_cushion_pct=8, and enable kernel_affinity=cpu_cooperative for gen workers. The kernel affinity change reduces hotspots during compaction.

nora: applied patch and restarted canary pool. patch snippet:
```json
{"runtime": {"microbatch_size": 6, "max_new_tokens": 256, "prefetch_kv": false, "mem": {"slab_cushion_pct": 8, "slot_compaction": "aggressive"}, "kernel_affinity": "cpu_cooperative"}}
```

ops-bot: canary rollout: orca-lite-v1.2-int4 -> a40-small (4 hosts) initiated by nora

anika: also drop kv_cache_max_entries to 1024 and set kv_eviction_policy=coldest_first for canary. That prevents single long prefixes from holding large transient allocations.

nora: added kv limits and started synthetic run (5000 reqs). results: 0 soft OOMs, p95 gen latency +40ms vs baseline, throughput ~-10%. logs: "alloc_fail:0 | p95: 260ms | p99: 420ms | avg: 140ms"

chris: tradeoff looks acceptable for stability. Can we add a smoke eval comparing token-level deltas between float16 and int4 outputs at max_new_tokens=256? want to ensure quality not regressing at the shorter default.

anika: kicked off eval suite (200 prompts). early delta metrics: sacreBLEU not applicable (chat), but rouge/embedding-similarity median=0.98, outliers 3/200 with minor formatting differences. No semantic regressions spotted so far.

nora: thumbs up. we'll keep conservative defaults for orca-lite in the model-catalog: microbatch 6, max_new_tokens 256, prefetch=false, slab_cushion 8, kv_max_entries 1024.

chris: follow-up ticket: infra should provide an automated heuristic to pick defaults based on model_size, quantization (int4/int8), and target GPU class. Also add a preflight smoke ramp that increases concurrency gradually (0 -> 30% -> 60%).

nora: adding notes to the onboarding checklist: always run frag-susceptibility test (short ramp with prefetchoff) and run eval dels if max_new_tokens reduced. :white_check_mark:

nora: initial error excerpts:
``
[2026-04-05T09:03:12Z] WARN gen_worker: transient_alloc_failed 32MB pool=kv_cache reason=freelist_fragmentation
[2026-04-05T09:03:12Z] INFO slot_compactor: pass completed freed=28MB duration_ms=55
[2026-04-05T09:03:13Z] WARN gen_worker: slowgen detected latency=980ms tokens=48
``

anika: great writeup. next steps: codify per-model safe-defaults in model-catalog UI and add an infra job that auto-applies conservative defaults when quantized models onboard to new GPU families.

chris: will own the infra ticket. thanks everyone.

nora: leaving canary open for 12h and will escalate if we see new tail regressions.
